description: A single-storey lean-to built into the gap where the terrace steps down, about eleven feet wide and roofed in one slope off the neighbour's gable, which makes it the smallest building on Filament Street by a margin that is almost funny. One window, and the window is at bench height rather than at eye height, so what you see through it from the pavement is a pair of hands and a last and nothing above the elbow. A boot hangs over the door on a wrought bracket, iron, the size of a coal scuttle, and it has been repaired twice itself.
name: Sole Survivor
